channel.title: InvestPR Media Monitoring
channel.description: Wins this period: PharmaEssentia (Taiwan) plans a $46M plant near San Juan, Toyota is investing $55M+ in its Toa Baja distribution center, Warmkraft (Tennessee) will put $16M into a defense-related facility in Mayagüez, and Polaris (Canada) advanced its Punta Lima battery storage project. Marriott's $38M Isla Verde renovation and the ATCO–Emera merger (LUMA co-owner) add outside-capital signals. Risks center on energy: LUMA's $48M fuel-cost deficit, the government's $100M claim against New Fortress Energy, Flotek's canceled PREPA contract, and business groups warning that high power costs threaten thousands of SMEs. The Oversight Board reports a stalled economy (activity index down 0.2%) and the Medicaid funding cliff in 2027 remains an investor-climate concern.
